Target company: Apple (AAPL). Apple develops and sells personal computing devices including iPhone, Mac and iPad, with operating systems and digital services.

Focal announcement: Apple previews new child safety features.

Decision cutoff: 2026-06-08T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Apple previews new child safety features. Published date: 2026-06-08. URL: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/06/apple-previews-new-child-safety-features.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today previewed a new suite of powerful, intuitive, and easy-to-use features designed to allow parents to more easily manage the content their children can see, who they can communicate with, and when they have access to apps. With software updates this fall, parents will be able to access new child safety features, including a simpler setup experience with a recommended set of essential apps, Ask to Browse, Time Allowances, and a redesigned Screen Time. A child account is required for children under 13 1 and available for children up to 18. For years, Apple has integrated guidance from leading clinical and child development research, as well as online safety experts, into its products and services, and continues to help advance research into children’s digital wellbeing. Apple Watch For Your Kids makes it possible for parents to reach their child and identify their location via Find My, while kids can also connect with family and friends through phone calls and messages, stay motivated to reach personalized Activity goals, express themselves through Memoji, and enjoy features that give them more independence, like Apple Maps, Apple Music, and Apple Cash.
